snippet.title: Meowstery Wisp - Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Meowstery Wisp is a social deduction game for 5-11 players, built around investigation, manipulation, and trust. Across five rounds, players search for artifacts to reach the final phase; while spies in disguise secretly hinder the investigation, and an occultist works toward a hidden master plan. No elimination until the final phase.

You can wishlist Meowstery Wisp on Steam:
